english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the feeling of contentment after a need or desire is fulfilled.
Use this for the inner satisfaction felt after other people admit that you were right.
Use this when the enjoyment specifically emphasizes a feeling of satisfaction.
Use this for the feeling of satisfaction or contentment a person experiences.

examples.english: Finishing this report gives me real satisfaction.
examples.traditional: 做完呢份報告，我真係有滿足感。
